player_actions: Voluntarily accompanies Kazama Ritsu and guarded medics escorting unknown severe neuromuscular respiratory patient to Kusa Central Hospital.

Gives Kusa border guards individualized safe restraint/handling recommendations for THREE captured old-mill attackers, including injuries and risks of vascular/nerve compression; instructs to arrange secure medical treatment/first aid in closed wing then transfer to Kusa prison when medically stabilized. No Shiki additional treatment/attacks, questions, thoughts or feelings.

timeline.event: Shiki tells Ritsu he will go with them, then instructs Kusa border guards. SPEAR fighter: medical-chakra senbon impaired right hand/wrist motor function, left foot dorsiflexion, other limb function present; disarm, keep separately, bind without excessive compression and check distal perfusion. SEAL woman: right-hand/left-foot motor deficits plus closed LEFT tibia fracture, must immobilize leg/support knee and not stand, check sensation, distal pulses, watch pressure. DOTON male: RIGHT FOREARM fracture and LEFT HUMERUS fracture plus prior shoulder damage, never bind both hands behind back or over fracture, splint/support both arms and assess finger perfusion and swelling, prevent one-hand seals by observation/approved restraints without vascular injury. Search weapons, tags, poisons, keep isolated. Hospital closed secure ward for immediate clinical stabilization and then guarded prison transfer once medically fit. Remaining officers implement protection and triage; no automatic completed prison transfer in scene.

Captured spear shinobi asks if they will be treated; Kusa guard says treatment before imprisonment. Seal woman reacts with resentment to being immobilized after Shiki broke tibia, says 'Ты сломал мне ногу, а теперь объясняешь, как её лечить?'. Doton man asks whether Shiki could simply have bound him but cannot finish. These are NPC own utterances, no Shiki answers assigned. Kusa guards arrange separate transport under armed watch; prisoners alive.

Medical convoy with Shiki and wounded but active Ritsu departs old mill eastbound to Kusa hospital, no new ambush; Ritsu tends oxygen and severe muscular hypoventilation, Tiyo continues near pump under guard. Weather rain diminishing, road to settlement. Does not automatically ask Shiki to manipulate drugs or move apart from voluntarily accompanying them.

Patient with neuromuscular weakness develops reduced chest wall excursions, weak inspiratory effort and evidence CO2 retention despite SpO2~94% ON supplemental oxygen. Ritsu with team independently pauses transport, checks capnography (raised end-tidal CO2 suggestive but not direct arterial measurement), puts patient on portable assisted ventilation with mask and monitoring. Patient remains conscious, vital, breathing supported, continues unlabeled IV infusion. NO reserve dose administered; still available contingent on worsening/clinician assessment. Tiyo distressed, says near hospital.

Medics arrive at closed intensive treatment wing of Kusa Central Hospital, hand off patient to trained hospital respiratory team. IV still active, spare reserve retained separately with patient under controlled supervision, small lab sample already isolated for drug analysis with no results yet. Stationary assisted positive pressure ventilation set up; pulse/circulation stable, patient alive with impaired motor and clear consciousness, sensory/eye movements preserved, not magically healed. Ritsu bandaged LEFT shoulder, patient guarded. Ritsu reports an observed recent puncture mark on patient's LEFT VOLAR WRIST distinct from known IV site; reason unknown and not yet proven linked to plot. Patient can understand and use eyes to answer simple yes/no, Ritsu asks Shiki whether there is reason to expect new attempted kidnapping at hospital; she has requested 2 armed Kusa internal security who arrive at ward corridor. Hospital is defensively guarded, no third assault actually seen.
